description: Whether a draft made with draft was done: waiting (not yet), done (posted, listed or sent: link is what it became), discarded (they said no) or expired (7 days passed). With no id, their last 10 drafts, newest first. cannot_now says why a waiting one can’t be done as it stands (the game sold since, say).

id.description: The draft’s id, from draft (optional: their last 10)

name: draft_status
title: A draft’s status
